title: Employees and their departments
statementMd:
List each employee's first and last name together with the name of their department. Employees without a department should not appear.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `last_name`, `department`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: An inner `JOIN` keeps only rows that match on both sides.
Alias the department name with `AS department`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.name AS department
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id;
```

An inner join drops employees whose `department_id` is NULL because they have no matching department.
